items.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Use ONLY the claims in the ESSENCE list below; every paragraph must correspond to at least one essence item (record indices). Do not add doctrines, comparisons, meta-commentary, or quoted terms. ESSENCE: [0] Refuge in all-abiding Śambhu; whirled student asks, teacher answers in verses. [1] Fourfold egg manifested by Lord's power-weight; enjoyer embodied is Śiva fettered. [2] Lord holds all forms as crystal takes colors; self moves/rests with world-mass. [3] Everywhere-self shines in mind-mirror; grace-pure mind mirrors light-formed self, will-knowing-acting replete.

paragraphs.text: The song opens with taking shelter: refuge in Shambhu, who abides in everything. A student comes spinning with questions, and the teacher answers — in verses. That question-and-answer is the frame holding everything that follows.

Then the world gets built in three quick strokes. First, the fourfold egg — everything that exists — is manifested by nothing but the weight of the Lords power; and the enjoyer who gets embodied inside it is Shiva Himself, in fetters. Second, the Lord holds every form the way a crystal takes on whatever color is put next to it; the self moves with the moving world-mass and rests with the resting one. Third, the everywhere-self shines inside the mirror of the mind; and when grace purifies that mind, it mirrors back a self made of light, complete with will, knowing, and acting.

ESSENCE: [0] Thought-free principle shines the thirty-six like mirror-towns; freedom effects the hard, Māyā veils; grasped knowing stains sixfold; the atom knows little now; husk-separate yet one, purified by path; mere proceedings ordered.

paragraphs.text: The thought-free principle shines all thirty-six levels the way a mirror holds whole towns inside it. Freedom pulls off the hard thing; illusion puts on the veil. paragraphs.text: Count the instruments: five for knowing, five for doing. Their objects start subtle and undivided — then mixing makes them gross. Creation husks consciousness over. paragraphs.text: Unreal orders of things arise, and the mechanism is delusion: shining things get darkened, and the not-self gets taken for the self, burst upon burst. The self nets itself the way a spider nets itself in its own web. But unwrapped, the supreme Shiva spreads out the play of bondage and release. States of waking, dreaming, sleeping shine inside a fourth that stays unveiled — the three told, the fourth beyond telling. Sky unsoiled, jars unsoiled.

ESSENCE: [0] Seeming follows states, Lord truly not; mirroring removed, delusion shattered; rooted done, no duty; triad remainders into being; difference left, being shines; brahman rests in power; untouched sky-flowered; all emitted in Śiva-name; three eggs created.

paragraphs.text: Seeming just follows whatever state you are in; the Lord Himself never does. Take the mirroring away and delusion shatters. What was rooted is done with; there is no duty left. The three leftovers resolve into being; difference gets left behind and being shines. Brahman rests in power. Untouched, like a flower in the sky. Everything gets emitted in Shivas name; three eggs created.

paragraphs.text: I drive the play-wheel, pure-formed. Everything shines in me; everything spreads out from me. The universe-formed shines in all things. The senseless seer just sits there composing systems about it. Cross Maya and she dissolves like water poured into water. Made of Shiva means beyond sorrow. Fruits come from contact, and company is hard — fools keep cycling, bound. Heaped-up deeds burn away like cotton in a flame.

paragraphs.text: Get things done and let the fruit go — that ends being born again. The freed seed never sprouts. Own-formed, all fearless, all griefless; I, the jewel-heaped Lord, free of misfortune. No abode, no journey: manifestation with the knot cut. Knotted, then cut: freed while still in the body. The burnt seed cannot un-birth a deed. The limited mind contracts knowing down into the body. The stainless vow, stated.

paragraphs.text: Beyond touch, the firm Lord keeps making hosts — worlds, beings, all of it. Awake and Shiva-made, you do not wander anymore. Say not-mine and mean it, and the fruit drops off. Sacrifice your thoughts and they turn to flame. Covered, calmed: free anywhere. Extremes finished, untouched. Moving slowly, free of opinions. The host of delusion cannot touch you. Nothing is separate, so praise is needless.

Knowing told: all is self, made of that.
